summary: Android app to calculate and display a car’s (as exact as possible) mileage.
known_issues: Intermittent failure when recording a fill-up (user reports: "Failed to record fill up issue occurs").

existing_features.title: Implement a mileage (fuel efficiency) calculator workflow where a user can record odometer readings and fuel added for each fill-up and view computed mileage over time (e.g., km/L and L/100km, or MPG if user selects miles/gallons).
Add authenticated per-user data storage using Internet Identity so each user’s fill-up history is private and persistent.
Create a dashboard UI that lists fill-ups chronologically, shows computed mileage per entry, and includes basic filtering/sorting (e.g., by date range, newest/oldest).

Provide a clear onboarding/help section explaining how “exact mileage” is approximated from fill-up/odometer data, and how to improve accuracy (e.g., fill to same level, consistent units, handling partial fills).

Apply a coherent visual theme appropriate for a car mileage tracker (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) and enforce it consistently across screens; avoid blue/purple as primary brand colors.
Add generated static images to support the app’s branding and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve images from the backend).
Update the dashboard fill-up history list so each fill-up entry renders as a compact single-line row (one visual line per entry) rather than the current multi-line card layout.

Prevent users from submitting a new fill-up while the authenticated backend actor is not ready, and provide a clear, actionable UI message when submission is unavailable (e.g., not signed in, actor still initializing).

Improve fill-up submission error handling so that failures show a more informative error message to the user (in English) and capture sufficient details in console logs to diagnose intermittent failures.

Make the add-fill-up mutation resilient to transient initialization/race conditions by ensuring it uses the same actor readiness gating as read queries (i.e., do not allow mutation execution until actor is present and not fetching), and avoid intermittent failures immediately after login/logout transitions.
Replace the dashboard section title text "Your Mileage" with "Breeza Mileage".

Update the app name branding text shown in the UI and browser metadata from "Mileage Tracker" to "Breeza Mileage" wherever it is used as the app name (e.g., top header title, onboarding header title, profile setup welcome title, and the HTML document title).

new_feature_requests.summary: Build an Android app that tells a car’s mileage (fuel efficiency) as accurately as possible.
Display the history list entries in a single-line layout (compact one-line per fill-up).
Update branding text: replace "Your Mileage" with "Breeza Mileage" across the app UI (and app name where applicable).
